sections.title: The, plus a plural object
sections.content: To mean particular apples, put *a / az* in front of the plural object: *az almákat*, *a körtéket*. The verb is then definite, as always after *a / az*: *Kérem az almákat. Vesszük a körtéket.* A colour before the noun does not change: *a piros almákat*, *a zöld körtéket*. The plural and the *-t* stay on the noun.

items.english: Do you want the red peppers?
I won't take the green pears.

sections.content: The verb follows the article, not the plural: *az almákat* is definite, so *kérem*; *almákat* alone is not, so *kérek*. Do not use the singular when you mean several: *az almákat*, not *az almát*.
